item.powergrid.electrozapper.tooltip.sum: Fires a lightning bolt that bounces off of nearby enemies, splitting the damage between them. Can be powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
item.powergrid.electrozapper.tooltip.beh: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
Provides _Energy_ to Equipment that requires it
Stores energy at a rate depending on the _Supplied Voltage_
item.powergrid.electrobaton.tooltip.summ: Pushes back and stuns enemies (if they aren't too strong) when powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
item.powergrid.electrobaton.tooltip.beha: Attacked enemies will be _stunned_ and _no durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
item.powergrid.portable_drill.tooltip.su: Mines blocks with the strength of a diamond. When powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_, it mines faster the longer you use it.
item.powergrid.portable_drill.tooltip.be: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
item.powergrid.portable_saw.tooltip.summ: A saw for sawing wood. Can be powered with _Energy_ from a _Portable Battery_
item.powergrid.portable_saw.tooltip.beha: _No durability_ will be used. Instead, _Energy_ is drained from the Battery
Sneak to harvests whole trees at once
block.powergrid.thermometer.tooltip.summ: A simple device which measures the temperature of things
block.powergrid.thermometer.tooltip.beha: Measures the temperature of the device it is pointed at
Measures current and maximum temperature of the device it is placed on over time
item.powergrid.multimeter.tooltip.summar: A multi-purpose tool, handful to anyone who wants to play with electricity
item.powergrid.multimeter.tooltip.behavi: Can be used to probe voltage between terminals and current flowing through wires
item.powergrid.incomplete_circuit.toolti: Use _Mechanical Arms_ to insert used components and complete the circuit
item.powergrid.circuit_schematic.tooltip: Sneak right-click to convert into an assembled circuit
block.powergrid.circuit_design_table.too: Design and write _Circuit Schematics_. If you want to place components, you must have them in your inventory.
Writes the current design into a schematic item
block.powergrid.potato_battery.tooltip.s: An all natural source of green energy
item.powergrid.wire_cutter.tooltip.behav: Removes a hanging wire, or selected segment of a block wire
item.powergrid.wire_cutter.tooltip.condi: When Shift R-Clicked on a block wire
item.powergrid.integrated_circuit.toolti: The integrated circuit is back! By deploying a circuit over a _compatible_ piece of equipment, you can _boost_ it, improving its _performance_ for a _limited_ number of uses. Beware, once boosted, the item will consume _twice_ as much power.
An _almost perfect_ voltage source. Set the output voltage with the _slider_ or _/powergrid_ command.
An _almost perfect_ current source. Set the output current with the _slider_ or _/powergrid_ command.
block.powergrid.fe_inverter.tooltip.summ: Converts _Forge Energy_ into _Electricity_ using advanced technology. Use the _Control Pin_ to adjust the output voltage and improve power conversion.
item.powergrid.triode.tooltip.summary: A vacuum tube that amplifies signals. Anode current is controlled by a small voltage on the _Grid_.
item.powergrid.triode.tooltip.behaviour1: Conducts from _Anode_ to _Cathode_. A small change in _Grid_ voltage produces a large change in anode current.
item.powergrid.pentode.tooltip.summary: A vacuum tube like a triode, with an extra _Screen Grid_ (G2) between the control grid and the anode for higher gain.
item.powergrid.pentode.tooltip.behaviour: The _Screen_ must be positively biased. It shields the anode from the control grid and allows higher gain than a triode.
item.powergrid.thyratron.tooltip.summary: A gas-filled tube that latches on when anode voltage exceeds a grid-controlled strike voltage. Once fired, the grid loses control until anode current drops or reverses.
item.powergrid.thyratron.tooltip.behavio: Fires when anode voltage exceeds the strike voltage set by the _Grid_. A positive grid pulse can trigger conduction.
Stays _latched on_ even if the grid is driven negative. Extinguishes only when anode current drops below holding or reverses.
